definitions.explanation: dishes served alongside rice in a Japanese meal; anything eaten with rice as the main accompaniment

examples.japanese: おかず⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: I made too many side dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧おかず⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: This side dish goes really well with rice.

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written {御菜|おかず} or {御数|おかず}, but hiragana is most common.

CULTURAL NOTE:
A standard home meal is rice, soup (⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧), and おかず: everything else eaten with the rice, whether the main meat or fish dish or small vegetable dishes. ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧のおかず⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧? asks what's for dinner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{飯|はん}のおかず (something to eat with rice)
- おかずになる (to make a good dish to go with rice)
- ご{飯|はん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{進|すす}むおかず (a dish that makes you eat more rice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主菜|しゅさい}→主菜：04995_shusai⟧ / ⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧: the formal terms for the main dish and the smaller vegetable side dishes; おかず covers both
- ⟦{惣菜|そうざい}→惣菜：05827_souzai⟧: ready-made dishes bought at a deli or supermarket
- ⟦{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ→付け合わせ：08257_tsukeawase⟧: a garnish on the same plate as a main dish
